data.one_liner: Source code generation builders and utilities for the Dart build system.
data.what_it_does: Provides a framework for writing Dart code builders and a convention for human and tool-generated code to coexist. Exposes a developer-friendly API on top of the analyzer and build packages.
use_when: You are writing custom code generators for Dart libraries or annotations
You need to build custom Builders that consume and produce Dart code
avoid_when: You are simply looking to use existing generators like json_serializable or freezed without writing your own
strengths: Exposes a developer-friendly API on top of lower-level analyzer and build packages
Supports multiple code generators integrating seamlessly in the same project via shared part builders
weaknesses: Requires understanding of the Dart build system and analyzer APIs
data.setup_notes: Add source_gen to dependencies or dev_dependencies, and configure builders in a build.yaml file.
